notes.title: Lair of the Titans Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32094853/3a280225d7b739b8faae77ffdaa2e11a3430dca0.png[/img]

The trailer for Lair of the Titans is the first thing getting updated, it is nothing more than a work in progress video.

  We have three levels currently available for launch, and we are working on a fourth that we hope to have ready by the 9th for the Early Access launch.
